description: This file contains API client functions for authentication-related operations, including fetching user organizations by email and logging in with organization ID, email, and password. It imports configuration, utility functions for hashing, and URL resolution, and exports async functions that perform fetch requests to backend endpoints.

methods.name: fetchUserOrganizationsByEmail
methods.description: Fetches organizations associated with a given email address by calling the backend API.

methods.name: loginWithOrgEmailPassword
methods.description: Performs login using organization ID, email, and password, handling encryption of the organization ID and processing the response to extract tokens and tenant info.
